commands.review_summary:
The PR moves embedded-runner `session.ended` trajectory recording to the post-cleanup path, adds `session.cleanup_completed`, and carries terminal status/error into the deferred event.

PR surface: Source +2. Total +2 across 1 file.

Reproducibility: yes. Source inspection shows current main and `v2026.6.11` record normal-path `session.ended` immediately after `model.completed` before cleanup, while recorder timestamps are generated at `recordEvent()` time.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] The remaining blocker is a narrow mechanical repair to flush the trajectory recorder after the final post-cleanup events.

target.title: fix(telemetry): record session.ended trajectory event after flush, not inline with model.completed
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102014 — the `session.ended` trajectory event timestamp equals the last
`model.completed` timestamp, making session cleanup duration invisible in traces.

## Root Cause

`session.ended` was recorded inside the try block immediately after
`model.completed` in the same synchronous execution. Both events shared the
same millisecond timestamp because `new Date().toISOString()` was called
synchronously.

## Fix

1. Defer `session.ended` from the try block to after cleanup in the finally block
2. Emit `session.cleanup_completed` before `session.ended` so cleanup completion
   is visible in trajectory exports
3. Carry `attemptTrajectoryTerminal.status` and `terminalError` into the
   deferred event

## Evidence

### Real Behavior Proof

Trajectory export from live agent session on this branch:

```
seq=5  model.completed                 06.695
seq=6  trace.artifacts                 06.698
seq=7  session.cleanup_completed       06.860   ← cleanup done (162ms later)
seq=8  session.ended                   06.860   ← session terminated
```

`session.cleanup_completed` proves cleanup ran between `model.completed`
and `session.ended`. The 162ms gap reflects actual teardown and state
persistence, not just synchronous overhead.

### Autoreview (claude-sonnet-5)

```
autoreview --mode branch --engine claude --model claude-sonnet-5
→ patch is correct (0.95), no accepted/actionable findings
```

- [x] `oxfmt --check` passes
- [x] `oxlint` passes
- [x] `git diff --check` passes
- [x] autoreview clean (claude-sonnet-5, 0.95)
